translations.idiomatic: Yougui sent troops to build Fengyi. After only two courses of wall it collapsed, several hundred Ningzhou soldiers went on a great rampage, and Yougui could not restrain them.

sentences.zh: 詔用張獻甫代之。

translations.literal: An edict replaced him with Zhang Xianfu.
translations.idiomatic: An edict replaced him with Zhang Xianfu.

sentences.zh: 遊瑰畏亂，委軍輕出，還京師，拜右龍武統軍。

translations.literal: Yougui, fearing disorder, left his army lightly and returned to the capital, being appointed commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Yougui, fearing disorder, left his army lightly and returned to the capital, being appointed commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 卒，謚曰襄。

translations.literal: He died; his posthumous title was Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: He died. His posthumous title was Xiang.

sentences.zh: 廣弘者，自言宗室子。

translations.literal: Guanghong claimed to be a member of the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghong claimed to be a member of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 始為浮屠，妄曰：「我嘗見嶽、瀆神，當作天子，可復冠。」

translations.literal: At first he was a Buddhist monk and recklessly said: "I have seen the gods of the mountains and rivers. I am destined to become Son of Heaven — I may don the cap again.
translations.idiomatic: At first he was a Buddhist monk and recklessly said, "I have seen the gods of the mountains and rivers. I am destined to become Son of Heaven — I may don the cap again.

sentences.zh: 男子董昌舍廣弘於資敬寺，召相工唐郛視之，教郛告人曰：「廣弘且大貴。」

translations.literal: A man named Dong Chang lodged Guanghong at Zijing Temple and summoned the physiognomist Tang Fu to examine him, instructing Fu to tell people: "Guanghong is about to attain great eminence."
translations.idiomatic: A man named Dong Chang lodged Guanghong at Zijing Temple and summoned the physiognomist Tang Fu to examine him, instructing Fu to tell people, "Guanghong is about to attain great eminence."

sentences.zh: 乃誘欽緒、神策將魏循、李傪、越州參軍事劉昉等作亂。

translations.literal: He thus induced Qinxu, the Shence generals Wei Xun and Li Song, and Liu Fang, an aide in the Yuezhou administration, to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: He thus induced Qinxu, the Shence generals Wei Xun and Li Song, and Liu Fang, an aide in the Yuezhou administration, to rebel.

sentences.zh: 昉家數具酒大會廣弘所，陰相署置。

translations.literal: At Fang's home they set out wine repeatedly and held great gatherings at Guanghong's place, secretly appointing one another to offices.
translations.idiomatic: At Fang's home they set out wine repeatedly and held great gatherings at Guanghong's place, secretly appointing one another to offices.

sentences.zh: 又妄曰：「神戒我十月十日趣舉。」

translations.literal: Guanghong also falsely said: "The gods warned me to rise on the tenth day of the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghong also falsely said, "The gods warned me to rise on the tenth day of the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 約欽緒夜擊鼓，噪淩霄門，焚飛龍廄，循等以神策兵迎廣弘，事捷，大剽三日。

translations.literal: They agreed that Qinxu would beat drums by night, raise an uproar at Lingxiao Gate, and burn Feilong Stable; Xun and the others would welcome Guanghong with Shence troops, and once the affair succeeded there would be three days of great plunder.
translations.idiomatic: They agreed that Qinxu would beat drums by night, raise an uproar at Lingxiao Gate, and burn Feilong Stable. Xun and the others would welcome Guanghong with Shence troops, and once the affair succeeded there would be three days of great plunder.

sentences.zh: 循、傪上變，乃禽廣弘及支黨鞫仗內，付三司訊實，皆殊死。

translations.literal: Xun and Song reported the plot; Guanghong and his accomplices were seized and interrogated within the palace, the Three Offices verified the facts, and all were executed by extraordinary penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Xun and Song reported the plot. Guanghong and his accomplices were seized and interrogated within the palace. The Three Offices verified the facts and all were executed by extraordinary penalty.

sentences.zh: 廣弘臨刑，色自如。

translations.literal: At execution Guanghong's expression was as calm as ever.
translations.idiomatic: At execution Guanghong's expression was as calm as ever.

sentences.zh: 由是禁人不得入觀、祠。

translations.literal: Because of this, common people were forbidden to enter Daoist temples and shrines.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this, common people were forbidden to enter Daoist temples and shrines.

sentences.zh: 杜希全

translations.literal: Du Xiquan
translations.idiomatic: Du Xiquan

sentences.zh: 杜希全，京兆醴泉人。

translations.literal: Du Xiquan was a native of Liquan in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Du Xiquan was a native of Liquan in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 以裨將隸郭子儀，積功勞至朔方節度使。

translations.literal: As a staff general he served under Guo Ziyi and by accumulated merit rose to military commissioner of Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: As a staff general he served under Guo Ziyi and by accumulated merit rose to military commissioner of Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 軍令整嚴，士畏其威。

translations.literal: His military discipline was strict and orderly; the troops feared his authority.
translations.idiomatic: His military discipline was strict and orderly. The troops feared his authority.

sentences.zh: 奉天之狩，希全與鄜坊節度使李建徽、鹽州刺史戴休顏、夏州刺史時常春引兵赴難。

translations.literal: During the emperor's flight to Fengtian, Xiquan together with Li Jianhui, military commissioner of Fufang, Dai Xiuyan, prefect of Yanzhou, and Shi Changchun, prefect of Xiazhou, led troops to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: During the emperor's flight to Fengtian, Xiquan together with Li Jianhui, military commissioner of Fufang, Dai Xiuyan, prefect of Yanzhou, and Shi Changchun, prefect of Xiazhou, led troops to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 次漠谷，為賊邀擊，乘高縱石下之，強弩雜發。

translations.literal: At Mogu they were ambushed by rebels who, from the heights, rolled stones down on them and sent crossbows firing in mixed volleys.
translations.idiomatic: At Mogu they were ambushed by rebels who, from the heights, rolled stones down on them and sent crossbows firing in mixed volleys.

sentences.zh: 德宗使援之，不克，還保邠州。

translations.literal: Emperor Dezong sent reinforcements but they could not break through; they withdrew to hold Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Dezong sent reinforcements but they could not break through. They withdrew to hold Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊平，遷檢校尚書左僕射、靈鹽豐夏節度使，封餘姚郡王。

translations.literal: After the rebels were suppressed, he was promoted to honorary Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and military commissioner of Ling, Yan, Feng, and Xia, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Yuyao.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebels were suppressed, he was promoted to honorary Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and military commissioner of Ling, Yan, Feng, and Xia, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Yuyao.

sentences.zh: 將即屯，獻《體要》八章，砭切政病。

translations.literal: Just before taking up his garrison he submitted eight chapters entitled Essentials, sharply criticizing flaws in government.
translations.idiomatic: Just before taking up his garrison he submitted eight chapters entitled Essentials, sharply criticizing flaws in government.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉納，賜《君臣箴》一篇。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and adopted them, bestowing a piece entitled Admonition for Lord and Minister.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and adopted them, bestowing a piece entitled Admonition for Lord and Minister.

sentences.zh: 尋兼夏綏銀節度都統，建言：「鹽州據要會，為塞保鄣。

translations.literal: Soon he was made overall commander of the Xia, Sui, and Yin circuit as well, and submitted a memorial: "Yanzhou occupies a strategic junction and serves as a frontier barrier.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made overall commander of the Xia, Sui, and Yin circuit as well, and submitted a memorial: "Yanzhou occupies a strategic junction and serves as a frontier barrier.

sentences.zh: 自平涼背盟，城陷於虜，於是靈武勢縣，鄜坊單逼，為邊深患，請復城鹽州。」

translations.literal: Since the covenant at Pingliang was broken and the city fell to the barbarians, Lingwu has been left exposed and Fufang isolated in peril — a grave border affliction. I request that Yanzhou be rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: Since the covenant at Pingliang was broken and the city fell to the barbarians, Lingwu has been left exposed and Fufang isolated in peril — a grave border affliction. I request that Yanzhou be rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 乃詔希全及朔方、邠寧、銀夏、鄜坊、振武及神策行營諸節度合選士三萬五千屯鹽州，又敕涇原、劍南、山南軍深入吐蕃，牽撓其力，使不得犯塞。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered Xiquan along with the Shuofang, Bin-Ning, Yin-Xia, Fufang, Zhenwu, and Shence field commands jointly to select thirty-five thousand troops to garrison Yanzhou; it also commanded the Jingyuan, Jiannan, and Shannan armies to penetrate deep into Tibetan territory and divert their strength so they could not raid the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered Xiquan along with the Shuofang, Bin-Ning, Yin-Xia, Fufang, Zhenwu, and Shence field commands jointly to select thirty-five thousand troops to garrison Yanzhou. It also commanded the Jingyuan, Jiannan, and Shannan armies to penetrate deep into Tibetan territory and divert their strength so they could not raid the frontier.

sentences.zh: 執築凡六千人，閱二旬畢。

translations.literal: Those assigned to construction numbered six thousand in all; within twenty days the work was finished.
translations.idiomatic: Those assigned to construction numbered six thousand in all. Within twenty days the work was finished.

sentences.zh: 由是虜憚，不輕入。

translations.literal: From this the barbarians were deterred and did not lightly invade.
translations.idiomatic: From this the barbarians were deterred and did not lightly invade.

sentences.zh: 希全居河西久，頗越法橫肆，帝數容掩其短。

translations.literal: Xiquan had long governed west of the river and frequently transgressed the law with arrogance and license; the emperor often indulgently covered his faults.
translations.idiomatic: Xiquan had long governed west of the river and frequently transgressed the law with arrogance and license. The emperor often indulgently covered his faults.

sentences.zh: 豐州刺史李景略名出希全上，疑逼己，遂排劾之。

translations.literal: The Fengzhou prefect Li Jinglue was more renowned than Xiquan; Xiquan suspected him of encroaching on his position and therefore impeached him.
translations.idiomatic: The Fengzhou prefect Li Jinglue was more renowned than Xiquan. Xiquan suspected him of encroaching on his position and therefore impeached him.

sentences.zh: 帝為斥以答其意。

translations.literal: The emperor dismissed Li to satisfy Xiquan's wishes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dismissed Li to satisfy Xiquan's wishes.

sentences.zh: 素苦風眩，稍劇，益忌忍，遂誣殺判官李起，吏下累息。

translations.literal: He had long suffered from vertigo; as it grew worse he became ever more suspicious and cruel, and falsely accused and killed his administrative aide Li Qi; under him the clerks scarcely dared breathe.
translations.idiomatic: He had long suffered from vertigo. As it grew worse he became ever more suspicious and cruel, and falsely accused and killed his administrative aide Li Qi. Under him the clerks scarcely dared breathe.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈司空。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously honored as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously honored as Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 邢君牙

translations.literal: Xing Junya
translations.idiomatic: Xing Junya

sentences.zh: 邢君牙，瀛州樂壽人。

translations.literal: Xing Junya was a native of Leshou in Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Junya was a native of Leshou in Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 少從幽薊、平盧軍，以戰功歷果毅、折沖郎將。

translations.literal: In youth he followed the Youji and Pinglu armies and, through battle merit, rose through the ranks of guoyi and zhechong commanders.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he followed the Youji and Pinglu armies and, through battle merit, rose through the ranks of guoyi and zhechong commanders.

sentences.zh: 安祿山反，從侯希逸涉海入青州。

translations.literal: When An Lushan rebelled, he followed Hou Xiyi across the sea into Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When An Lushan rebelled, he followed Hou Xiyi across the sea into Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 田神功為兗鄆節度使，使君牙將兵屯好畤防盛秋。

translations.literal: When Tian Shegong was military commissioner of Yan and Yun, he had Junya lead troops to garrison Haozhi against the autumn raids.
translations.idiomatic: When Tian Shegong was military commissioner of Yan and Yun, he had Junya lead troops to garrison Haozhi against the autumn raids.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃犯京師，代宗出陜，以扈從功，累封河間郡公。

translations.literal: When the Tibetans invaded the capital and Emperor Daizong withdrew into Shaan, Junya earned merit as an escort and was repeatedly enfeoffed, reaching Marquis of Hejian commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tibetans invaded the capital and Emperor Daizong withdrew into Shaan, Junya earned merit as an escort and was repeatedly enfeoffed, reaching Marquis of Hejian commandery.

sentences.zh: 建中初，李晟從馬燧討田悅，以君牙為都將，在武安、襄國間凡五戰，斬馘功最。

translations.literal: Early in Jianzhong, when Li Sheng followed Ma Sui against Tian Yue, Junya served as commander-in-chief; between Wu'an and Xiangguo they fought five engagements and his record of beheadings and captures was foremost.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jianzhong, when Li Sheng followed Ma Sui against Tian Yue, Junya served as commander-in-chief. Between Wu'an and Xiangguo they fought five engagements and his record of beheadings and captures was foremost.

sentences.zh: 德宗出奉天，晟率君牙倍道赴難，徙屯渭橋，軍中便宜，惟君牙得豫。

translations.literal: When Emperor Dezong went out to Fengtian, Sheng led Junya by forced marches to the rescue; when they moved their camp to Weiqiao, of all who could advise on discretionary matters within the army, only Junya was consulted.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Dezong went out to Fengtian, Sheng led Junya by forced marches to the rescue. When they moved their camp to Weiqiao, of all who could advise on discretionary matters within the army, only Junya was consulted.

sentences.zh: 晟在鳳翔，數行邊，常以君牙守。

translations.literal: When Sheng was at Fengxiang he often toured the frontier and regularly left Junya in charge.
translations.idiomatic: When Sheng was at Fengxiang he often toured the frontier and regularly left Junya in charge.

sentences.zh: 晟入朝，代為鳳翔觀察使。

translations.literal: When Sheng came to court, Junya replaced him as governor of Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: When Sheng came to court, Junya replaced him as governor of Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 俄領節度，檢校尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Soon he took command of the circuit as well, with the honorary title of Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he took command of the circuit as well, with the honorary title of Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃歲犯邊，君牙劭耕講戰以為備，戎不能侵。

translations.literal: The Tibetans raided the frontier every year; Junya urged farming and drilled for battle as preparation, and the barbarians could not penetrate.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetans raided the frontier every year. Junya urged farming and drilled for battle as preparation, and the barbarians could not penetrate.

sentences.zh: 又城隴州平戎川，號永信城。

translations.literal: He also fortified Pingrongchuan in Long Prefecture and named it Yongxin City.
translations.idiomatic: He also fortified Pingrongchuan in Longzhou and named the fort Yongxin City.

sentences.zh: 卒官，贈司空。

translations.literal: He died in office and was posthumously made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He died while holding office and was posthumously made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 初，布衣張汾者，無紹而干君牙，軒然坐客上。

translations.literal: At first there was the commoner Zhang Fen, who without introduction sought out Junya and boldly sat above the other guests.
translations.idiomatic: At first there was the commoner Zhang Fen, who without introduction sought out Junya and boldly took the seat above the other guests.

sentences.zh: 會吏擿簿書，以盜沒宴錢五萬，君牙怒其欺，汾不謝去，曰：「吾在京師，聞邢君牙一時豪俊，今乃與設吏論錢，云何？」

translations.literal: When clerks inspected the account books and found fifty thousand in feast funds misappropriated, Junya was angry at the deception. Fen did not apologize but left, saying: "I heard in the capital that Xing Junya was a heroic figure of the age — and now you wrangle with a petty clerk over money. What sort of conduct is this?
translations.idiomatic: When clerks inspected the account books and found fifty thousand in feast funds misappropriated, Junya was angry at the deception. Fen did not apologize but left, saying, "I heard in the capital that Xing Junya was a heroic figure of the age — and now you wrangle with a petty clerk over money. What sort of conduct is this?

sentences.zh: 君牙慚，遽釋吏，引為上客，留月餘，以五百縑為謝。

translations.literal: Junya was ashamed, immediately released the clerk, made Fen an honored guest, kept him more than a month, and gave five hundred bolts of silk in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Junya was ashamed. He immediately released the clerk, made Fen an honored guest, kept him more than a month, and gave five hundred bolts of silk in thanks.

sentences.zh: 其屈己好士類此。

translations.literal: His humility and love of worthies were of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: In humbling himself and honoring men of talent he was like this on other occasions as well.
